issues.description: The solution's Client defines assembleBookstore(check: Bool) but calls assembleBookstore() without arguments. The template's commented signature (and the problem's tasks/tests) expect assembleBookstore() with no parameters. This parameter mismatch will cause a compilation error and test failure (the call and the declaration do not match).
issues.suggested_fix: Make the assembleBookstore function signature match its call and the template/tests. Either remove the extra parameter from the solution implementation (change to private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore) or update the call to pass the required Bool, but the intended fix is to remove the unused 'check: Bool' parameter so assembleBookstore() has no parameters.
